Leeflets – AI-Powered Sales Agents for Influencer Marketing

name: Leeflets
summary: AI sales-agent platform for coaches and creators: agents answer DMs and chats and turn followers into leads.
description: Leeflets sells teams of AI sales agents (its FAQ brands the product BuzzGrid) that connect to Instagram, LinkTree, YouTube and WhatsApp, push DMs and chats into a universal inbox, and recommend products and handle objections 24/7. Pricing runs from a free plan to Premium at $29.99/mo and PRO at $59.99/mo, aimed at coaches, creators and small business owners.
contains: AI agent marketplace for coaches and creators
agents for Instagram, YouTube, WhatsApp and LinkTree
universal inbox for DMs, chats and messages
site says it is loved by 500+ small business owners
